title: ByteDance Agrees To Reel In Its AI Models To Protect Hollywood IPs
excerpt: TikTok’s parent company signed a memorandum of understanding with The Motion Picture Association.
content_html:
TikTok’s parent company signed a memorandum of understanding with The Motion Picture Association.

Cheng Xin/Getty Images

Hollywood and ByteDance have seemingly squashed their beef revolving around AI models infringing on studios' intellectual property. The Motion Picture Association (MPA) announced in a press release that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with TikTok's parent company, which details a shared framework to protect against copyright infringement of the trade group's members.

The MPA, whose members include Disney, Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery, said that "this agreement represents significant cooperation between the two organizations." The trade association even added that ByteDance's latest release of Seedream 5.0 Pro and Seedance 2.5 reflect its "continued advances in IP protections." According to the press release, this memorandum applies to all AI models from ByteDance, including those used on TikTok, TikTok USDS Joint Venture, CapCut and Dreamina. 

The memorandum comes after the MPA sent a cease-and-desist letter to ByteDance in February, accusing the company's AI models of using copyrighted material without permission. Shortly after, ByteDance responded by pledging it would strengthen its safeguards around unauthorized use of intellectual property and likeness, even later reportedly suspending Seedance 2.0's global rollout. Since then, MPA's CEO and chair, Charles Rivkin, said the association has had "constructive engagement" with the ByteDance, adding that the Chinese company has implemented "meaningful guardrails" with its AI models. On the other hand, Hollywood studios are currently in court for a lawsuit against Midjourney, also accusing it of copyright infringement.

content_html_zh:
TikTok 母公司与美国电影协会签署了谅解备忘录。

程欣/盖蒂图片社

好莱坞和字节跳动似乎已经平息了围绕人工智能模型侵犯电影公司知识产权的争论。 美国电影协会 (MPA) 在一份新闻稿中宣布，它已与 TikTok 的母公司签署了一份谅解备忘录，其中详细介绍了一个共同框架，以防止该行业组织成员的版权侵权。

MPA 的成员包括迪士尼、派拉蒙和华纳兄弟。 Discovery 表示，“这项协议代表了两个组织之间的重大合作。” 该行业协会甚至补充说，字节跳动最新发布的 Seedream 5.0 Pro 和 Seedance 2.5 反映了其“在知识产权保护方面的持续进步”。 根据新闻稿，该备忘录适用于字节跳动的所有人工智能模型，包括 TikTok、TikTok USDS Joint Venture、CapCut 和 Dreamina 上使用的模型。

这份备忘录是在 MPA 二月份向字节跳动发出停止函后发布的，指控该公司的人工智能模型未经许可使用受版权保护的材料。 不久之后，字节跳动做出回应，承诺将加强对未经授权使用知识产权和肖像的保护措施，甚至据报道后来暂停了 Seedance 2.0 的全球推广。 此后，MPA 首席执行官兼主席查尔斯·里夫金 (Charles Rivkin) 表示，该协会与字节跳动进行了“建设性接触”，并补充说，这家中国公司已为其人工智能模型实施了“有意义的护栏”。 另一方面，好莱坞电影公司目前正在法庭对《中途旅程》提起诉讼，同样指控其侵犯版权。
